one_idea.line: Yes. The Tom's Hardware bill page behind the six SPLIT beats is the old page the auditor is reading, blurred as ground (focus 1 on every beat with a device), so the slam words and the counter stay the only figure and it adds no second idea. The page is sharp only inside th_head on proof and lines. The see-through title scrim now sits over the sofa and closet plates, which are the idea's own money and skeleton.

no_invented_numbers.line: No invented figure. The backdrop is the piece's own real page (asset tomshw, sha256 bdd1e519...); at the renderer's focus-1 blur (18 px on a 1080 panel) its headline figures cannot be read, and they are the piece's own $195,000 and $33,000 anyway. The counters show only the bill-billed and bill-after rows; no slam word or tape has a digit; l_krafton's '258 days' is printed on its own page.
